caption:
Ek thekedar akele sheet sambhal le, to site pe kaam kitna aasan ho jayega?

VAJRA PP shuttering sheet se slab, beam aur column ka kaam tez aur smooth banta hai. Sahi handling ke saath ply se 2-3 guna zyada chalti hai.
